meta.name: Foundry Yard
meta.axes: x east, z north, y up, origin at map center
meta.symmetry: rotate 180 degrees about the origin: (x,z) to (-x,-z) maps team A half to team B half
meta.theme: abandoned industrial depot at golden hour

rules: All boxes are axis-aligned and solid, stairs are already expanded into steps (about 0.27 m rise, 0.5 m run).
Heights: 1.2 m crouch cover, 1.4 m standing cover, 2.6 m container, 3.2 m mezzanine floor, 6 m building walls and perimeter.
Roofs sit at y 6.0 to 6.3 and are never walkable; skylight gaps are intentional light shafts.
Keep doorways at least 3 m wide and lanes at least 3.5 m wide; keep at least 2 routes between any two zones.
Mirror every edit through the 180 degree rotation so the map stays fair.
The sun is perpendicular to the north-south team axis so neither team looks into it.
The map has no weapons, characters or pickups; spawn entries are positions only.

sightlines.name: Center diagonal, broken by freight cars

sun.shadows: the only shadow-casting light, 2048 map, ortho frustum +/-45 m

lighting.budget: at most 8 point lights visible at once, none cast shadows; use emissive materials for lamps and signs
lighting.readability: cover is lighter than the floor, team colors appear only in the bays, interiors are 30 to 50 percent of exterior brightness so doors read as transitions

metrics.routes: three per team: west through the Foundry, center through the Plaza, east through the Yard
